question: Which users use GitHub?
answer: Five users use GitHub: Alex Johnson (a.johnson.contractor@example.com), Jane Doe (jane.doe@example.com), John Doe (john.doe@example.com), Lisa Park (l.park@example.com), and Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@example.com).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.name, u.email FROM v_user_apps AS ua JOIN v_users AS u ON ua.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ua.app_name LIKE '%github%' ORDER BY u.name
